meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: Claude 会把 Resend 邮件通道接入 NanoClaw:从 channels 分支拷入适配器、注册到通道入口、安装指定版本的依赖包、构建并运行注册测试,再引导你填 Resend 的 API key、发件地址与 webhook 密钥。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加邮件(Resend)通道时触发。技能会按其 Apply 步骤改动代码,而 Resend 账号与域名配置需你在 Resend 后台自行完成。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Resend 邮件通道
say.note: 会执行拷贝、注册、装依赖与构建

say.text: 把 bot 的发件地址设成 bot@yourdomain.com
把我设成 owner,并给我发一封 hello 邮件
say.note: 会注册用户、授予 owner 并发送欢迎邮件

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Resend email channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it in the channel barrel, installs a pinned adapter package, builds, runs the registration test, and prompts for Resend credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add an email (Resend) channel to NanoClaw; the skill edits code per its Apply steps, while the Resend account and domain setup is done by you in the Resend dashboard.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Runs copy, register, install and build steps.

say_en.text: Set the bot's sending address to bot@yourdomain.com
Make me the owner and email me a hello
say_en.note: Creates the user, grants owner, sends hello.
